data.animaCaption: Bundled in a camel duffel coat and red plaid scarf with snowflakes melting on her white beret, she holds a ribbon-tied handmade gift box forward in both gloved hands. Warm amber string lights glow across her cheeks against the crisp indigo snowfall.
data.promptProse: Captured in a close evening portrait framed by softly blurred golden Christmas light bokeh in the foreground, Ayachi Nene stands beneath illuminated street trees as gentle snow falls. She wears a tailored camel wool duffel coat with horn toggles, a thick red plaid cashmere scarf tucked around her chin, a white knit beret, and white wool gloves, holding a small dark-wrapped gift box with a crisp red ribbon toward the viewer. Warm tungsten light from the festive street lamps kisses her flushed cheeks and silver twin tails, contrasting against the cool blue winter snow and faint white breath in the cold air.
data.story: 平安夜的细雪落在街树暖黄的灯串上。宁宁把藏在身后的小礼盒郑重递到你面前，毛线手套边缘还沾着刚化开的雪粒，连鼻尖都被寒风冻得微红——「虽然织得不算完美……圣诞快乐，希望这个冬天能替我暖着你。」
